details: Bitcoin has notably surpassed the $80,000 mark, even touching $81,000 in Asian trading hours, propelled by significant institutional inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). On May 4, these ETFs recorded a substantial net inflow of $532 million, contributing to a broader upward trend across the cryptocurrency market, with Ethereum also holding above $2,300 and XRP around $1.40.
title: Bitcoin Rallies Above $80K on Robust ETF Demand

details: U.S. Senators have reached a compromise on the CLARITY Act, a significant legislative development for the digital asset industry. This agreement, finalized by Senators Tom Tillis and Angela Alsobrooks, prohibits crypto companies from offering interest on stablecoin holdings akin to bank deposits, while still allowing incentives tied to genuine platform usage. This move aims to provide much-needed regulatory clarity for stablecoins.
title: Senate Compromise Advances Stablecoin Clarity Act

details: Escalating geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran, including military actions and their impact on oil prices, are creating a complex environment for financial markets. While a recent report indicated that Bitcoin experienced a "tailwind" rallying nearly 2% during early Asian trading amidst the news of President Trump's "Project Freedom" initiative, other analyses suggest that such tensions could increase volatility and risk aversion. However, strong Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF inflows demonstrate some resilience in the crypto market.
title: US-Iran Tensions Yield Mixed Crypto Market Response

details: Toncoin (TON) emerged as a top performer, surging 8.1% since midnight UTC and 28% over the past 24 hours. This significant rally follows an announcement by Pavel Durov that Telegram will take over as the primary driving force behind the TON network, leading to a substantial 40% jump in its futures open interest.
title: Toncoin (TON) Rallies 28% on Telegram Network Shift

details: Recent central bank interest rate decisions, particularly those from late April 2026, have contributed to a period of indecision and weakness in the cryptocurrency market. The expectation of prolonged higher interest rates tends to reduce overall liquidity and diminish risk appetite for speculative assets like cryptocurrencies, as borrowing costs remain elevated and traditional markets like bonds become relatively more attractive.
title: Central Bank Policies Dampen Crypto Market Confidence
